sourceScript.activatedBy: Julian explicit no-pollen-bags direction, applied by Codex

directorStatement.audienceFeeling: Calmed, attentive, and gently drawn toward Keen’s coming departure.
directorStatement.emotionalChange: Aida moves from still listening to a quiet, chosen action.
directorStatement.theLaugh: No comedy beat; the scene plays as soft anticipation.
directorStatement.visualSurprise: The pendant glow opens into a pier vision without becoming flashy.
directorStatement.carryForward: Aida heads toward the forest to reach Keen before the journey.

shots.purpose: Reset the pace through Aida’s quiet listening ritual.
shots.performanceAssignment: Aida sits beside the bowl with the wand just off the rim, then eases it into a slow circle. Her breathing settles, her eyelids close, and the pendant glow gradually lifts light across her face.
shots.camera: Slow push-in from wide shore to calm medium.
shots.openingPose: Aida seated frame-center beside the bowl, wand hovering near the rim, eyes open.
shots.visualPayoff: Aida’s closed-eyed stillness fills the quieted cove.

continuityOut.cameraSide: ocean remains screen-left, forest remains screen-right

shots.seedancePrompt:
image_1 defines exactly one Aida: an elder bear with long flowing lilac-purple hair, a jewelled headdress across her brow, layered purple robes and a rose quartz pendant at her chest. Refer to it strictly. Do not use its pose or background.
image_2 defines only the sanctuary environment: a quiet cove shoreline with gentle waves and Aida's crystal singing bowl. Do not use or invent characters from it.
Exactly one Aida; no other characters appear.
The rose quartz pendant and its pink glow belong to Aida only.
Feature-quality stylized 3D CGI. Plush character materials with subsurface scattering; soft fur with individual strands catching the light; glossy eyes with bright catchlights. Warm amber key light with cool blue fill and a soft rim light; teal-orange cinematic grade. Shallow depth of field with soft bokeh, gentle ambient occlusion, subtle film grain. Appealing exaggerated proportions, large expressive eyes, soft rounded features. Emotionally warm atmosphere.
No dialogue in this beat; no narrator, no crowd, no added speech.

Shot 1 — the ritual. Camera: a slow push-in from a wide of the quiet cove toward Aida seated beside the crystal bowl. Gentle waves roll onto the shore. She runs the wand softly around the bowl's rim and a low shimmering tone rises <sustained crystal-bowl tone>; the cove seems to quiet around it — the water calms, the air stills. She closes her eyes. Her rose quartz pendant begins to glow, and soft pink light rises across her face from below, growing steadily stronger. Hold on her still, pink-lit face for two full seconds. End state: Aida perfectly still with eyes closed, her face lit in rose-pink, the bowl's tone sustained — a describable frame.

The singing-bowl tone is diegetic sound, not music. No music. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text. No watermark. No extra characters.

shots.purpose: Aida's vision shows her who needs her — Keen on the edge of leaving home, and the mother letting him go.
shots.performanceAssignment: The vision opens on a wooden pier beside a small sailboat on bright blue water. Keen stands beside his Mum and checks his satchel straps, again, then one more time — each check smaller and quicker than the last, his nerves showing in the repetition. His wrists and forearms stay completely bare. Mum watches with a proud smile that cannot quite hide her worry; one paw lifts slightly toward him and settles back.
shots.camera: Vision POV, slow gentle drift toward Keen and Mum on the pier; never cut.
shots.openingPose: Keen beside his Mum on the wooden pier near the sailboat, hands reaching toward satchel straps, bare wrists visible.
shots.cutInMotivation: The pendant glow and bowl tone dissolve into Aida’s inner vision.
shots.visualPayoff: Keen mid-check beside Mum, held as the vision's final image and Scene 3 opening plate.
prohibited: No wristbands, bands, bracelets, cuffs or straps on Keen

Shot 1 — the return. Camera: close on Aida as the pink glow fades gently from her eyes and they open. She places a paw over her heart. A soft knowing smile arrives by degrees, not all at once.
